how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-feathermoon-stronghold-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3788:details:1: BA colleague of mine would like to speak with you about the research you are doing in conjunction with the ⟦E2⟧. He is a druid by the name of Quintis Jonespyre, and he resides here in ⟦E1⟧. He would like to confer with you about morrowgrain... and he very much would like for you to keep our discussion from the ears of the Arch ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:3788:details:2: If you're interested, speak with him; no doubt, all will be revealed once you do.
rows.quest:3788:completion:0: I thank you for coming, weary traveler! Allow me to introduce myself - I am Quintis Jonespyre, druid and humble servant of Malfurion and the ⟦E2⟧. My colleagues (General Shandris Feathermoon and the Protectorate - mayhap you've heard of us) and I wanted to talk with you about the work you are doing for Fandral Staghelm in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:3788:completion:1: Before we get much further, I'd like to ask that our discussion stay between just us. If you have no problem with this, then we may proceed.
rows.quest:3791:details:0: Let me to be frank with you, ⟦1⟧. I'm interested - nay, concerned with why the Arch ⟦E3⟧ in ⟦E4⟧ is using the name of the ⟦E2⟧ as well as the Circle's resources to procure vast amounts of morrowgrain. I'm a researcher - curses are my specialty. I've heard that morrowgrain, under the right conditions, exude qualities like other herbs used in primitive curses.
rows.quest:3791:details:1: I want to know more, and I ask for your help. Bring me ten morrowgrain, and I will be sure to take care of you.
rows.quest:3791:progress:0: I'm looking for ten morrowgrain - that should be enough to at least get my research started.  I'll no doubt burn through a lot of those going down wrong paths, but such is the nature of research.
rows.quest:3791:completion:0: Gah, these morrowgrain make me feel... weird. What in the name of ⟦E6⟧ is Staghelm up to with these things?
rows.quest:3791:completion:1: Anyway, thank you again for your help. Here's a little something... you know, for the effort. My research on morrowgrain is going to take a while, and I no doubt am going to need more. While I'm at it, I suppose I could take the time to see if morrowgrain have some pertinent alchemical uses. Still, I feel uncomfortable even being around them.
